entities.summary: The Tatabánya–Pápa railway line is a railway line in Hungary. It runs 93.2 kilometres (57.9 mi) from Tatabánya to Pápa. Most of the line no longer hosts passenger service, and it is partially abandoned in the vicinity of Pápa. Hungarian State Railways owns and operates the line. Tatabánya–Pápa railway line is a railway line from Europe. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
